description:
Export a finished validation or scoring file back to the connected SFTP/FTP server.
When to use: When the user wants results written to their SFTP/FTP server.
Parameters: fileId — the finished job's file id; exportPath (optional) — defaults to the path in the account's SFTP settings.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.

exportPath.description: Destination path on the server. Optional: without it the export path configured on your ZeroBounce account is used.

fileId.description: File ID of the completed bulk job

name: export_sftpfile
title: Export results to SFTP
